observations: Photo 0 shows a front-loading washing machine with a silver finish, wrapped in plastic. The LG logo is visible on the top left of the control panel. A sticker on the front says 'Direct Drive'. Another sticker indicates 'Wash & Dry 7kg'.
Photo 1 shows the back of the machine, wrapped in plastic, with a coiled grey drain hose and a coiled black power cord. Red stickers with partial text 'GILE' and 'FRA' are visible.
Photo 2 is a similar rear view, showing the same components as photo 1, with a barcode sticker on the lower right. The machine appears to be new or unused, still in protective wrapping.
All photos show a watermark 'HOME AFFAIRS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: beautiful silver colour lg 7kg inverter direct drive wash & dry washing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the silver color, LG logo, 'Wash & Dry 7kg' sticker, and 'Direct Drive' sticker. The 'inverter' claim is not visible but is common in LG Direct Drive models; it is unverified but plausible.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have been damaged during storage or transport despite the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, door opening/closing, and control panel responding to inputs.

risks.risk: The 'inverter' claim is not visually confirmed; it may be a non-inverter model.
risks.proof: Photo of the model number plate or user manual showing 'inverter' specification.

risks.risk: The machine may be a reconditioned or refurbished unit, not new as implied by the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Serial number check or proof of purchase from LG or authorized dealer.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and operating.
Photo of the model number plate or user manual.
Proof of purchase or warranty document.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an LG 7kg Wash & Dry Direct Drive washing machine. The seller's claims are mostly supported by visible evidence. Hidden risks exist regarding functionality, inverter status, and condition, but the item can be priced at its worst case (as not working or non-inverter) until proven otherwise.
